Fields.Name: LOD 0-1 Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) where the model switches from LOD 0 to LOD 1, times the LOD Type's scale. With Enable Crossfade the two LODs blend from here to here + Play. Without it the switch happens at Border + Play going out and Border − Play coming back. 9999 = never.

Fields.Name: LOD 0-1 Play Distance
Fields.Description: Transition width (m, not scaled) at the LOD 0-1 border. With Enable Crossfade it is the crossfade length past the border. Without it, it is a margin that stops flicker (out at Border + Play, back at Border − Play).

Fields.Name: LOD 1-2 Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) where the model switches from LOD 1 to LOD 2, times the LOD Type's scale. Works like LOD 0-1 Border Distance. 9999 = never.

Fields.Name: LOD 1-2 Play Distance
Fields.Description: Transition width (m, not scaled) at the LOD 1-2 border: the crossfade length, or the switch margin without Enable Crossfade.

Fields.Name: LOD 2-3 Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) where the model switches from LOD 2 to LOD 3, times the LOD Type's scale. Works like LOD 0-1 Border Distance.

Fields.Name: LOD 2-3 Play Distance
Fields.Description: Transition width (m, not scaled) at the LOD 2-3 border: the crossfade length, or the switch margin without Enable Crossfade.

Fields.Name: LOD 3-4 Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) where the model switches from LOD 3 to LOD 4, times the LOD Type's scale. Works like LOD 0-1 Border Distance.

Fields.Name: LOD 3-4 Play Distance
Fields.Description: Transition width (m, not scaled) at the LOD 3-4 border: the crossfade length, or the switch margin without Enable Crossfade.

Fields.Name: LOD 4-5 Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) where the model switches from LOD 4 to LOD 5, times the LOD Type's scale. Works like LOD 0-1 Border Distance.

Fields.Name: LOD 4-5 Play Distance
Fields.Description: Transition width (m, not scaled) at the LOD 4-5 border: the crossfade length, or the switch margin without Enable Crossfade.

Fields.Name: Texture LOD Border Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) beyond which the model uses its low-resolution textures. It is scaled by the LOD Type's texture scale and the game's texture-distance setting. 0 = texture LOD off (always full resolution).

Fields.Name: Texture LOD Play Distance
Fields.Description: Margin (m) around Texture LOD Border Distance that stops flicker: low resolution from Border + Play, full resolution again below Border − Play. Scaled together with the border.

Fields.Name: Enable LOD Crossfade
Fields.Description: On: LOD changes blend over each LOD Play Distance past the border. Off: LODs switch instantly, and Play Distance becomes a margin around the border.

Fields.Name: Draw Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) where the model starts to fade out, times the draw scale of Load Balancer Scale ID. It is fully gone at Draw Distance + Draw Fade Range. 9999 = always drawn.

Fields.Name: Draw Fade Range
Fields.Description: Distance (m, not scaled) over which the model fades out after Draw Distance. 0 = disappears at once.

Fields.Name: Shadow Draw Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) where the model's shadow starts to fade out, times the shadow scale of Load Balancer Scale ID. It is fully gone at Shadow Draw Distance + Shadow Fade Range. 9999 = always.

Fields.Name: Shadow Fade Range
Fields.Description: Distance (m, not scaled) over which the shadow fades out after Shadow Draw Distance. 0 = disappears at once.

Fields.Name: Motion Blur Distance
Fields.Description: The model gets motion blur only while it is closer than this (m), times the LOD Type's motion-blur scale. 0 = never.

Fields.Name: Casts Point Light Shadows
Fields.Description: The model casts shadows from point lights. An instance's own setting can override this. Off when no row is found.

Fields.Name: Casts Sun Shadows
Fields.Description: The model casts shadows from the directional (sun) light. An instance's own setting can override this. On when no row is found.

Fields.Name: Receives Shadows
Fields.Description: The model receives shadows. An instance's own setting can override this. On when no row is found.

Fields.Name: Shadow Only
Fields.Description: The model is drawn only as a shadow. An instance's own setting can override this.

Fields.Name: Drawn in Reflections
Fields.Description: The model is drawn by the reflection camera. An instance's own setting can override this.

Fields.Name: Drawn Only in Reflections
Fields.Description: The model is drawn only by the reflection camera. An instance's own setting can override this.

Fields.Name: Include LOD Map Level
Fields.Description: What level of LodMap to include

Fields.Name: Ignore Far Clip
Fields.Description: Read for assets. The game reads it into the asset's draw settings; its rendering effect was not traced.

Fields.Name: LOD Type
Fields.Description: Picks the LoadBalancerDrawDistScaleParam rows whose value at the current load level scales this model's distances. The row is LOD Type for the LOD borders, 100 + LOD Type for texture LOD, and 400 + LOD Type for motion blur. 0–10.

Fields.Name: Shadow LOD Offset
Fields.Description: LOD levels added when the model is drawn into shadows, so shadows can use a simpler LOD.

Fields.Name: Follow Camera on XZ Plane
Fields.Description: Read for assets. The game reads it into the asset's draw settings; its effect was not traced.

Fields.Name: Draw in Skydome Phase
Fields.Description: Read for assets. The game reads it into the asset's draw settings; its effect was not traced.

Fields.Name: Distant View Border Distance
Fields.Description: Read for assets (m). The game reads it into the asset's draw settings (30 when no row is found); its effect was not traced.

Fields.Name: Distant View Play Distance
Fields.Description: Read for assets (m), paired with Distant View Border Distance. The game reads it into the asset's draw settings (5 when no row is found); its effect was not traced.

Fields.Name: Grid Activation Limit Distance
Fields.Description: Read for assets (m). The game reads it into the asset's draw settings (-1 when no row is found); its effect was not traced.

Fields.Name: Grid Activation Limit Play Distance
Fields.Description: Read for assets (m), paired with Grid Activation Limit Distance. The game reads it into the asset's draw settings (10 when no row is found); its effect was not traced.

Fields.Name: Z-Sort Offset (Ignore Far Clip)
Fields.Description: Read for assets. The game reads it into the asset's draw settings; its effect was not traced.

Fields.Name: Shadow Alpha Test Distance
Fields.Description: Alpha testing is used for the model's shadow only while the model is closer than this (m). 9999 = always. On when no row is found.

Fields.Name: Forward Draw Envmap Blend Type
Fields.Description: Read for assets. The game reads only whether it is 0 into the asset's draw settings; its effect was not traced.

Fields.Name: Load Balancer Scale ID
Fields.Description: LoadBalancerNewDrawDistScaleParam row (0–47) that scales Draw Distance and Shadow Draw Distance as the load balancer lowers quality. A missing row or an ID of 48 or above means no scaling.
